args.title: Fix dedupe to handle overlapping statement days uploaded together
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

Modify the dedupe logic to correctly identify duplicates when two statements with overlapping days are uploaded together, so that duplicates such as days appearing twice between consecutive month uploads are detected and counted properly.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/dedupe.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The dedupe function in src/ingest/dedupe.ts currently misses duplicates for overlapping days when two statements are uploaded together in a batch. It treats each batch independently without catching duplicates across them. Fixing this requires enhancing the dedupe logic to detect duplicates across overlapping ranges in the uploaded data.
